title: 第二十五章望月宗宗主第二十六章化解恩怨
content_zh:
“喝呀！！！”
苏阳丝毫不管毕长老此刻的震惊之色。
本就砸下去的长棍，再度被其举起，那是一团金色的火焰，此刻正熊熊燃烧在长棍四周。
“给我去死！”
砰！
第一棍砸下，毕长老咬牙抵挡。
砰！
第二棍砸下，毕长老的身躯不由朝下沉落。
砰！
第三棍砸下，毕长老的神情已经扭曲到了极致。
砰砰砰！
又是连续几根狠狠砸下，此刻的苏阳仿佛拥有数不尽的力量，疯狂的模样，让毕长老这位高手都不由产生了恐惧之感。
同时，也让毕长老彻底愤怒道：“小子，给我滚开！”
月光之力，又一次爆发，不过毕长老身上的气息，也在迅速消减，看来长时间施展高级武学，的确太耗费灵气。
“哼，老东西，今天你也别想离开了。”苏阳冷视着毕长老，虽然二人的境界有着明显差距，可苏阳此刻不知道哪里来的勇气，能够说出这般狂妄之话。
紫电狂狮见自己的大哥又雄起了，自然是无比欣喜。
斗战圣法，生生不息，只要敢战敢打，战意便会永远不散。
这也是为何苏阳能够一次次站起来，一次次爆发出强大力量的原因！
毕长老见苏阳此刻极为可怕，又将目光看向烈阳光柱里始终闭着眼睛的王依依，转动几下眼眸后，突然起飞，进入烈焰光柱里面，拉着王依依的手就往外拽。
然而，一股强大的力量从王依依体内爆出，毕长老不由被震飞而出，狂吐鲜血。

只见王依依此刻缓缓睁开了双眸，两团火焰燃烧在双眸之中，死死看着苏阳。
面对再度重生的王依依，苏阳也不畏惧，与其目光对视。
同样是燃烧的战意。
就在苏阳准备出手的时候，只见王依依突然开口道：“苏阳，你杀不了我，至少现在你杀不了。”
苏阳闻言，目露凶光，语气冰冷道：“你说杀不了，我就杀不了么？刚才能够杀你一次，现在也一样可以。”
“王依依，你我之间，不是你死就是亡！”
“苏阳，虽然你的至尊之血的确帮了我很大的忙，不过那也只是锦上添花罢了。我的火凤血脉早就觉醒，如今能够重生一次，便能重生第二次，你想杀我，只是徒劳无功。”
“我可以给你个机会，等你踏入神武境，你我再来决一死战。”
“哈哈哈，何须等到那个时候，我现在就能灭了你。”
苏阳丝毫没有退让，不管如何今日之事都得有个结果，不仅是因为要杀王依依，而是拖下去对自己更为不利。
就算自己用不了多久就能突破到神武境，可是那个时候的王依依，又岂会止步不前呢？若是让她去了望月宗，那就更难以报仇了。
content_en:
"Drink!!!"
Su Yang didn't care at all about Elder Bi's shocked look at this moment.
The long stick that had been smashed down was lifted up again. It was a ball of golden flames, burning blazingly around the long stick at this moment.
"Go to hell!"
Bang!
The first stick hit, Elder Bi gritted his teeth to resist.
Bang!
The second stick hit him, and Elder Bi's body couldn't help but sink downwards.
Bang!
With the third blow of the stick, Elder Bi's expression was distorted to the extreme.
Bang bang bang!
After hitting it hard with several more sticks in succession, Su Yang seemed to have countless power at this moment, and his crazy look made Elder Bi, a master, feel a sense of fear.
At the same time, Elder Bi was completely angry and said: "Boy, get out of here!"
The power of the moonlight exploded again, but the aura on Elder Bi's body was also rapidly diminishing. It seemed that using advanced martial arts for a long time consumed too much spiritual energy.
"Hmph, old guy, don't even think about leaving today." Su Yang looked at Elder Bi coldly. Although there was an obvious gap between the two people's realms, Su Yang didn't know where he got the courage to say such arrogant words.
The Purple Lightning Crazy Lion was naturally extremely happy to see that his eldest brother had become powerful again.
The holy law of fighting is endless. As long as you dare to fight, your fighting spirit will never fade away.
This is also the reason why Su Yang can stand up again and again and burst out with powerful power again and again!
Seeing that Su Yang was extremely frightened at this moment, Elder Bi looked at Wang Yiyi, who had always closed his eyes in the blazing beam of light. After turning his eyes a few times, he suddenly took off and entered the blazing beam of light. He took Wang Yiyi's hand and pulled him out.
However, a powerful force burst out from Wang Yiyi's body, and Elder Bi couldn't help being knocked out, vomiting blood.
I saw Wang Yiyi slowly opening her eyes at this moment, two balls of flame burning in her eyes, looking at Su Yang.
Facing the reborn Wang Yiyi, Su Yang was not afraid and looked into his eyes.
The same burning fighting spirit.
Just when Su Yang was about to take action, Wang Yiyi suddenly said: "Su Yang, you can't kill me, at least you can't kill me now."
When Su Yang heard this, his eyes flashed fiercely, and he said in a cold tone: "You said you can't kill me, so why can't I kill you? I was able to kill you once just now, and I can do the same now."
"Wang Yiyi, between you and me, it's either you or me who dies!"
"Su Yang, although your supreme blood has indeed helped me a lot, it is just the icing on the cake. My fire phoenix bloodline has long been awakened. Now that I can be reborn once, I can be reborn a second time. You want to kill me, but it is in vain."
"I can give you a chance. When you step into the realm of divine martial arts, we can fight to the death."
"Hahaha, why wait until then, I can kill you now."
Su Yang did not give in at all. No matter what happened today, there must be a result, not only because he wanted to kill Wang Yiyi, but also because prolonging it would be more detrimental to him.
Even if it doesn't take long for him to break through to the divine martial realm, how can Wang Yiyi stand still at that time? If she was allowed to go to the Moon Watching Sect, it would be even more difficult to take revenge.
